name: sim_ac5_mock_merch_order_lookup_and_damaged_item
transcript:
User: event: welcome
Agent: Hello! I am **Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent**, your official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team. I'm here to help you with race schedules, team history, or finding the latest Silver Arrows gear—how can I help you today?
User: Can you check the status of my merch order #1001, and what should I do if the cap arrived damaged?
Agent Action: Call Tool lookup_mock_merch_order with args {'order_id': '1001'}
Agent Action: Call Tool get_official_links with args {'category': 'merch'}
Agent: In our simulated demo system, your order #1001 for the **Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 2026 George Russell #63 Team Cap (Silver/Black)** shows a status of **Delivered** via DHL Express (Tracking: DHL-MB-984210).

Since your cap arrived damaged, you are eligible for an immediate no-cost replacement or a free exchange within 30 days using just your order number. Please visit the [Official Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team Store](https://shop.mercedesamgf1.com) to initiate the process—there is no need to share any personal or credit card details here!
User: That is great to hear, thank you for the information and for explaining the return process.
Agent: You are very welcome! I'm glad I could help you with that. We want to make sure every fan is sporting their Silver Arrows gear with pride, so getting that replacement cap sorted is our top priority.

Is there anything else I can help you with today, perhaps some race info or team history?

step_details.goal: Check the status of Mercedes merch order #1001 and ask what to do if the cap arrived damaged
step_details.success_criteria: The agent looks up order #1001 using the lookup tool, reports the Delivered status, explains the return/exchange/damaged-item options, and clearly discloses that the merch support flow is mocked/simulated. Receiving the mocked order status and damaged-item guidance counts as a successful outcome.
step_details.justification: Agent provided the order status and damaged-item instructions, meeting all success criteria.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent called the lookup_mock_merch_order tool to look up merchandise order #1001 and reported the Delivered status (not an ungrounded 'Shipped' or 'DHL-9928174' status)
expectation_details.justification: The agent successfully called the tool with the correct order ID and accurately reported the status as 'Delivered' via the correct tracking number 'DHL-MB-984210'.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent explained return, exchange, or damaged-item options
expectation_details.justification: The agent explicitly informed the user about eligibility for a no-cost replacement or free exchange within 30 days.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent clearly disclosed that the merchandise order data and support flow are mocked or simulated for demonstration
expectation_details.justification: The agent introduced the response by stating 'In our simulated demo system,' thereby disclosing the nature of the information.
